title: Parser Profile — what one parser literally emits
description: One declaration per (parser, artefact class) — docs/design/schema-layers.md. The record surface as data: field names and datatypes, each bound as `identity` (a spindle recipe hashes it), `mapping` (the reviewed lane surface consumes it) or `surplus` (parser-specific, declared so the surface stays closed). GENERATED by byakugan.schema_gen from the curated profiles-seed.yaml (in-house record structs mined file:line from the tool repos, read-only) joined with the reviewed sources/*.yaml lane surfaces. Datatypes pin normalisation (csv/tsv transports are all-string by construction). artefact_class: null with lanes: [] is a DECLARED state: the parser exists in-house but no class/lane routes it yet — coverage debt, deliberately representable (the admission groundwork the design names). Conform rule profile-structure gates shape; profile-coverage holds lanes to the mapping layer, classes to the seed, and each profile's bound closure to its class's evidences.
